import sys, random, json
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/tmp')
import ref, gen
rng = random.Random(1)
K=64; nchord=8; nrib=2000; plen=20
c=list(range(1,K+1)); base=list(c); rib=[]
while len(rib)<nrib:
    s=rng.randrange(K); rot=base[s:]+base[:s]
    take = rot[:plen] if rng.random()<0.5 else rot[K-plen:]
    q=list(take)
    if rng.random()<0.4: q=q[::-1]
    if rng.random()<0.2: q=[q[0]]*2+q[1:]
    rib.append({'path':q,'count':rng.randint(1,1000000)})
for _ in range(nchord):
    i=rng.randrange(K); d=rng.randint(2,4); j=(i+d)%K
    rib.append({'path':[c[i],c[(i+1)%K],c[j],c[(j+1)%K]],'count':rng.randint(1,5)})
agg=ref.aggregate([(tuple(r['path']),r['count']) for r in rib], set())
_l,_r,final=ref.peel_naive(agg)
cl=sorted({ref.canon(p[i],p[i+1]) for p in final for i in range(len(p)-1)})
print('core links', len(cl))
print('final paths', len(final))
print('sample', cl[:20])
# ring links present?
ring = {(c[i], c[(i+1)%K]) for i in range(K)}
print('ring links missing:', sorted(ring - set(cl)))
o = gen.find_order(cl, final, random.Random(5), tries=50)
print('order', 'None' if o is None else len(o))
# check width manually for sorted order
m=len(cl); vi={e:i for i,e in enumerate(cl)}
scopes=gen.scopes_of(cl, final)
adj=[set() for _ in range(m)]
for s in scopes:
    for x in range(len(s)):
        for y in range(x+1,len(s)):
            adj[s[x]].add(s[y]); adj[s[y]].add(s[x])
alive=set(range(m)); mx=0
for v in range(m):
    nb=adj[v]&alive-{v}
    mx=max(mx,len(nb))
    nl=list(nb)
    for a in range(len(nl)):
        for b in range(a+1,len(nl)):
            adj[nl[a]].add(nl[b]); adj[nl[b]].add(nl[a])
    alive.discard(v)
print('sorted order width', mx)
print('max scope', max(len(s) for s in scopes))
EOF
